streams.landscape: exec:ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -re -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x240:rate=15 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=16000 -c:v libx264 -preset superfast -tune zerolatency -g 15 -c:a aac -f rtsp -rtsp_transport tcp {output}
streams.wide: exec:ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -re -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=640x360:rate=15 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=16000 -c:v libx264 -preset superfast -tune zerolatency -g 15 -c:a aac -f rtsp -rtsp_transport tcp {output}
streams.portrait: exec:ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -re -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=240x320:rate=15 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=16000 -c:v libx264 -preset superfast -tune zerolatency -g 15 -c:a aac -f rtsp -rtsp_transport tcp {output}
